---
title: "Get Google Wallet pass"
api: "GET /api/documents/:id/pass/google"
description: "Retrieve Google Wallet save URL and JWT pass."
authMethod: "bearer"
---

Requires a valid user session. Returns `401` if unauthenticated. Foreign, revoked, or non-existent documents return `404`. Response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`.

<ParamField path="id" type="string" required>
  Document unique identifier.
</ParamField>

### Response

- Status: `200 OK`
- `Content-Type`: `application/json`
- `Cache-Control`: `no-store`

#### Signed Mode vs Stub Mode

When Google Wallet credentials (`GOOGLE_WALLET_ISSUER_ID`, `GOOGLE_WALLET_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`, `GOOGLE_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH`) are configured:
- Returns an RS256-signed JWT signed by the service account private key.
- Claims: `iss` (service account email), `aud: "google"`, `typ: "savetowallet"`, `iat`, `origins`, and `payload.genericObjects` containing document details with minimal visible fields (holder name, document number, license classes; no date of birth or address).
- `stub`: `false`

When credentials are not configured (development/testing fallback):
- Returns an unsigned stub JWT (`alg: "none"`, `iss: "wallet-backend-dev"`).
- `stub`: `true`

<ResponseExample>
```json 200 (Signed Mode)
{
  "jwt": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..sig...",
  "saveUrl": "https://pay.google.com/gp/v/save/eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "stub": false
}
```

```json 200 (Stub Mode)
{
  "jwt": "eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJpc3MiOiJ3YWxsZXQtYmFja2VuZC1kZXYi...`",
  "saveUrl": "https://pay.google.com/gp/v/save/eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0...",
  "stub": true
}
```
</ResponseExample>
